Tabby Cloud
Usage-Based Pricing
Pay only for what you use. Pochi bills based on the token cost of the LLMs you run, with $20 in free monthly credits. Billing happens automatically if usage exceeds $10, or at month-end for smaller amounts. You can set a budget anytime in your profile.
Model Choices
Free Features
Tab Completion is always free. No usage limits, no restrictions. If usage is unusually high, we may request a credit card to prevent abuse, but Tab Completion remains free.
